title: Bridal Nails Package
description: Premium bridal package with custom nail extensions, Swarovski embellishments, and chrome finishes. Includes trial session.
precautions: Patch test for adhesive allergy. Bring inspiration photos.

title: Nail Extension (Acrylic/Gel)
description: Lengthening service with acrylic or gel extensions. Choose from stiletto, coffin, or square shapes. Includes basic polish.
precautions: Not for nail biters. Avoid water 24hrs post.
aftercare: Use cuticle oil daily. Avoid using nails as tools.

title: Nail Art (Basic Designs)
description: Custom nail designs with hand-painted details and embellishments. Choose from various design options and colors.
precautions: Allergy test for adhesives. Avoid water 2hrs post.
aftercare: Avoid picking designs. Use top coat every 5 days.

title: Deluxe Manicure
description: Luxury treatment with paraffin wax dip, hot stone massage. Features diamond dust buffing and collagen-infused top coat.
precautions: Notify about skin conditions. Avoid if pregnant.
aftercare: Sleep with cotton gloves. Apply cuticle cream.

title: Basic Manicure
description: Essential nail care with cuticle treatment, nail shaping, and buffing. Includes moisturizing hand massage and polish.
precautions: Notify about nail fungus. Avoid water 1hr post.
aftercare: Use nail strengthener. Avoid harsh chemicals.

title: French Manicure
description: Classic French tip design with precision white tip and natural pink base. Features cuticle grooming and high-gloss top coat.
precautions: Avoid water 2hrs post-service. No recent cuticle cutting.
aftercare: Apply cuticle oil daily. Wear gloves for chores.

title: Basic Pedicure
description: Essential foot care with nail trimming, cuticle work, and exfoliation. Includes relaxing foot soak and polish.
precautions: Notify about diabetes. Avoid tight shoes post-service.
aftercare: Use foot powder. Wear cotton socks.

title: French Pedicure
description: Elegant French tips for toes with antimicrobial base coat. Includes callus removal, foot scrub, and extended calf massage.
precautions: No recent foot injuries. Diabetic consultation needed.
aftercare: Wear open shoes. Apply foot cream nightly.

title: Nail Cut & File (Hands)
description: Basic nail maintenance with sanitized tools. Includes nail trimming, shaping with crystal file, and buffing.
precautions: Notify about nail conditions. No recent injuries.
aftercare: Apply nail hardener. Avoid harsh chemicals.

title: Nail Cut & File (Feet)
description: Professional toenail care with orthopedic cutting technique. Features callus smoothing and antifungal spray.
precautions: Diabetic consultation required. No open wounds.
aftercare: Wear breathable shoes. Apply foot powder.

faqs.question: Medical grade?
faqs.answer: All tools sterilized after each use

title: Nail Polish (Hands Only)
description: Professional polish application with base coat, 2 color coats, and quick-dry top coat. Includes nail shaping.
precautions: Avoid water 1hr post. No recent cuticle cutting.
aftercare: Reapply top coat every 3 days. Use gloves for dishes.

title: Nail Polish (Feet Only)
description: Toenail polish application with antifungal base coat. Includes light foot massage and toe separators.
precautions: No open wounds. Wear open shoes post-service.
aftercare: Apply antifungal powder. Avoid tight socks.

title: Nail Polish (Hands & Feet)
description: Complete polish set for hands and feet with matching/contrasting colors. Features LED lamp for smudge-proof finish.
precautions: Avoid handbags/shoes that may smudge. No water 2hrs.
aftercare: Use cuticle oil. Avoid hot tubs 24hrs.
